title: 彭博：下半年布局，科技股之外谁有机会？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We've finished the first half of the year. We're on to the second half, it seems.
segments.zh: 上半年已结束，下半年即将开启。

segments.en: Memory chips and the memory trades certainly seem to be a really dominant trade in the first half of the year.
segments.zh: 存储芯片及相关交易无疑是上半年最主导的交易之一。

segments.en: How will we set up then going into the second? We have a huge sway in the market, actually, which would have been pretty much ignored.
segments.zh: 进入下半年如何布局？市场存在巨大波动，但几乎被忽视。

segments.en: I mean, we can talk about the AI lose, but actually beyond that, there's lots of sectors where there'd be things like healthcare, where there'd be things like staples,
segments.zh: 可以谈论AI，但除此之外，许多板块如医疗保健、必需消费品，

segments.en: which are trading at sort of valuations you haven't seen for a very long time. So, you know, at this point, if you get a little bit of that momentum coming out of those tech stocks, is there no value elsewhere or nothing in the public areas?
segments.zh: 估值处于很久未见的水平。如果科技股动能稍减，其他板块或公共领域是否还有价值？

segments.en: It's still good to be exposed to tech about at the market weight of tech, and to look maybe to give more emphasis to other sectors
segments.zh: 保持科技股的市场权重配置仍是好选择，同时可更多关注其他受益板块。

segments.en: that are indirectly benefiting as well. We've been, for example, very interested in the financials.
segments.zh: 例如，我们对金融板块非常感兴趣。

segments.en: In general, we are looking for a little bit of a broadening here.
segments.zh: 总体而言，我们期待市场进一步扩散。

segments.en: Volatility is still there, an uncertainty is still there.
segments.zh: 波动性和不确定性依然存在。

segments.en: And in this environment, for me, it makes sense to be quite nimble, and also not to take big paths either way,
segments.zh: 在这种环境下，保持灵活、不押注单边方向是合理的。

segments.en: but when the market throws your opportunity. As long as the earnings continue to be good, and to broaden out, I think we'll get continued gains through the second half.
segments.zh: 但当市场给你机会时，只要盈利持续向好且范围扩大，我认为下半年将继续上涨。

segments.en: Even though valuations are stretched, even if you take kind of the worst case scenarios, this rally could still have another year to run before you then saw a turnover.
segments.zh: 尽管估值偏高，即使考虑最坏情况，这轮反弹可能还有一年时间才会出现转折。

segments.en: Is this the moment for European equities to continue to build on an momentum that we've seen?
segments.zh: 现在是欧洲市场延续当前动能的时机吗？
